init.title: Torque upload authentication
init.description: Bearer authentication is {status} for this vehicle. Enter a new upload token to enable authentication or replace the current token. A blank token field keeps the current setting.

error.invalid_upload_token: Use a bearer token up to 1024 characters containing only letters, numbers, or the characters . _ ~ + / -. Optional padding with = is allowed at the end.
error.conflicting_upload_auth_options: Enter a new token or choose to disable bearer authentication.

user.title: Set up Torque OBD-II
user.description: Configure your vehicle for Torque OBD-II integration. The vehicle name will be used to create a unique API endpoint.

error.invalid_vehicle_name: Invalid vehicle name. Use only letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, and underscores.
error.invalid_email: Invalid email format. Please enter a valid email address.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle name is already configured.
